summary: Proof-worth entries for the bounded fixed recording producer with optional system audio.

entries.contract: One exact fixed display, window, or single-display global region retains its admitted canonical topology before one H.264 plus explicitly optional AAC-LC system-audio QuickTime producer acquires native or file authority and before every admitted sample. Video is mandatory, microphone and follow remain rejected, omission is exact video-only, and selected tracks start at one bounded common epoch under either arrival order. Successful output registration establishes availability separately from positive-byte first-sample truth, which requires positive per-track count and byte truth. Each track preserves independent monotonic sample, failure, drain, and finalization truth through operation result, artifact identity, and custody; writer-global failure marks every selected track. One absolute startup deadline covers native start and the remaining selected-track/common-media barrier, classifies every missing selected track, and gives missing mandatory video deterministic terminal precedence when both tracks are silent while the finite generation-bound owner survives callback loss, stop, cancellation, retirement timeout, false settlement, and delayed start failure after active evidence. Written-video frame progress and total artifact bytes validate against the exact per-track summary independently, so ready audio may advance bytes while video input is backpressured. Stop closes sample admission and drains its pre-boundary set; success requires positive bytes for every selected finalized track plus a nonempty artifact with the exact selected-track media identity; exact artifact-action decoding precedes effects; retain is typed unavailable; and atomic release/remove admission plus a durable exact-identity release phase recover only to released, rolled back, or explicit residual truth.
entries.worth: This catches topology scale, rotation, or peer drift; split startup budgets; startup callback loss and cancellation authority leaks; audio-first or video-first epoch divergence; nonmonotonic timestamps; zero-byte or zero-count first-sample truth; unbounded backpressure; audio-byte rejection while written-video frames remain zero; incomplete writer-global or both-silent per-track failure truth; wrong mandatory-video terminal precedence; silent selected-audio omission; post-stop sample admission; false zero-frame, null-artifact, track-set, or media-identity success; retain-unavailable drift; release fault-phase ambiguity and cleanup residue; Boolean, fractional, overflow, malformed-identifier, extra-key, wrong-type, or oversized-destination admission; suppressed progress-save failures; track-summary drift; help/schema drift; and native type errors without acquiring Screen Recording permission or recording pixels or audio.
entries.guard: schema and static source checks; an executable deterministic compiled harness runs the production recording adapter, registry, in-memory store, lifecycle, sample admission, multitrack coordinator, terminal truth, custody coordinator, and boot recovery with fake clock, video/audio callbacks, writer inputs/file, native session, and broker dependencies; runtime custody-schema validation; and whole-source Swift compile only. ScreenCaptureKit, AVAssetWriter, filesystem effects, daemon, raw repo build, native UI, TCC, pixels, audio, and media do not execute
